Healthcare Facility Evacuation Sheltering
ASPR TRACIE.
(2025).
Healthcare Facility Evacuation/ Sheltering.
U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office of the Assistant Secretary of Preparedness and Response.
The resources in this Topic Collection include plans, guidelines, lessons learned from recent events, and promising practices that can help healthcare facility staff develop evacuation and sheltering plans, and facilitate their training and exercise development.
